name: BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD
text: This turning point, the first strike of a non-KHORNE Legionary that is fighting (not retaliating) does 1 extra damage (7 at most), and KHORNE Legionaries' melee weapons get +1 to both Dmg values (7 at most) whenever they fight or retaliate.

name: IMPLACABLE
text: This turning point, weapons with Piercing 1 that shoot a friendly Legionary have Piercing Crits 1 instead, and NURGLE Legionaries ignore injured stat changes.

name: QUICKSILVER SPEED
text: This turning point, the melee weapons of an enemy fighting a friendly Legionary that has moved in an action have Hit worsened by 1, and an enemy more than 6 inches away shooting a SLAANESH Legionary that has moved has Hit worsened by 1. Never on top of the enemy being injured.

name: FICKLE FATES
text: This turning point, a friendly Legionary shooting a ready enemy has Balanced (Relentless instead if it already has Balanced), and a ready TZEENTCH Legionary being shot may retain one fail as a normal success whenever it retains any crit.

name: UNENDING BLOODSHED
text: When a friendly KHORNE Legionary is incapacitated in a fight, before it is removed, it strikes the enemy fighter once with one of its unresolved successes (normal or crit, your choice).

name: MUTABILITY AND CHANGE
text: When a friendly TZEENTCH Legionary is activated: until its activation ends it has +1 APL but cannot perform any action more than once. A Warrior's mark cannot be changed by Infernal Pact this turning point.

name: MALIGNANT AURA
text: When a friendly NURGLE Legionary performing Shoot picks a valid target: until the action ends its ranged weapons have Piercing 1 against every enemy within 3 inches of it, secondary targets included.

name: SICKENING CAPTIVATION
text: In a friendly SLAANESH Legionary's activation, before or after an action: pick an enemy visible to and within 4 inches of it. It has -1 APL until the end of its next activation.

name: WARDED ARMOUR
text: Warded Armour equipment, as a strategic gambit each turning point: pick a friendly Legionary; its Save becomes 2+ until the Ready step of the next Strategy phase.

name: CHAOS TALISMANS
text: Chaos Talismans equipment, as a strategic gambit each turning point: pick a Mark of Chaos. Until the end of the turning point, once in each activation, a friendly Legionary of that mark whose attack roll has two or more fails may take D3 damage to discard one fail and retain another as a normal success.
